title: Lesson 5. On sale
subtitle: Present Perfect Continuous, вопрос How long…? и распродажи

sections.title: 1. Sales in Belarus
sections.text: Belarusian shops offer {sales} and many {bonus} programmes. They include {Christmas} and New Year sales, holiday sales around {Women's Day} (8 March), {Defenders' Day} (23 February), St Valentine's Day and {Easter}. In {August}, before the new school year begins, most shopping malls and markets organise «{back to school}» sales and fairs. In addition, both online and offline shops have {nights of sales}, {Black Fridays} and {weekend sales}.
chain: Christmas / New Year, 8 March, 23 February, Easter
nights of sales, Black Fridays, weekend sales

sections.title: 2. Present Perfect Continuous
sections.text: Tense: the Present {Perfect} {Continuous}. Form: {have / has} + {been} + verb + {-ing}. We use it for an action that {started} in the past and {continues} up to now. The focus is on the {time period}, not on the result. It answers the question {How long}…? Signal words: {all day}, {for}, {since}. Examples: I've been waiting for my dad {for an hour}. We've been shopping {since 10 a.m.}. She hasn't been shopping {all day}. Have you been waiting for {a long time}?
chain: действие началось в прошлом и продолжается

sections.title: 3. What has been happening?
sections.text: Tim is very tired: he's been {working hard} lately. Josh can buy a new car: he's been {saving money} for 3 years. Pat's French is really good: she's been {learning} it for 5 years. Tara looks fit: she's been doing {yoga} for 3 years. John's trainers are dirty: he's been {skateboarding} in the rain. Chris looks suntanned: he's been {sunbathing}. Claire is still learning to play the guitar: she's been taking {music lessons} for 2 years.

flashcards.q: Какой вопрос задаём в Present Perfect Continuous?
flashcards.a: How long…? How long have you been waiting?

flashcards.q: Какие слова-сигналы у Present Perfect Continuous?

flashcards.a: Действие началось в прошлом и продолжается до сих пор; важен период времени.

I've been looking for the right tie (for / since) ages!
How long have you been collecting them? — …
